item.title: Learn to Read Games for Kids: Free Online Game
item.description: Learn to read games for kids with a free game that plays on a phone or tablet. Every word in it can be sounded out, and there is no sign-up. It is made for kids ages 4 to 8, from preschool to 2nd grade. It is free: print it or try it at sounditoutreading.com.
